reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute ticket volume roughly doubled starting August 2026, rising from a ~600/month baseline to 1180-1260/month (E-06), and the best-supported mechanism is a defect introduced by a billing import validation rule change around August that causes bills to be calculated incorrectly regardless of read source. This is evidenced by disputed bills being majority ACTUAL-read-type (1785 vs 1240 ESTIMATED, E-03), which rules out a pure upstream read-delivery or estimate-substitution failure, while ticket response times remain within SLA (E-04), ruling out ticket-handling capacity as the driver.

This is evidenced by disputed bills being majority ACTUAL-read-type (1785 vs 1240 ESTIMATED, E-03), which rules out a pure upstream read-delivery or estimate-substitution failure, while ticket response times remain within SLA (E-04), ruling out ticket-handling capacity as the driver.
reasoning_quality_informational.ideal_final_problem: BV-17 validation rejects valid firmware-v4.2 AMI reads (unit-scale mismatch on H-MDMS-BILL) and substitutes estimates.
